title: Tumorsphere Passage for Breast Cancer Stem Cells
protocol: In serum-free and phenol red-free DMEM, add 20 ng/ml EGF, 20 ng/ml bFGF, and 1X B27 supplement for sphere media preparation.
Alternatively, add 1% FBS (v/v) into phenol red-free DMEM without EGF, bFGF, or B27 supplement.
Aspirate media from flask containing cancer cells, wash twice in 1X PBS, and trypsinize cells.
Centrifuge cells at 300 x g at room temperature (15-25°C) for 10 minutes.
Decant supernatant and resuspend cells carefully in sphere media prepared from Step 1.
Use 40 μm cell strainer cap filter to obtain single-cell suspension.
Isolate cellular subsets of interest via FACS or MACS if necessary.
Determine cell viability via 0.4% Trypan Blue dye exclusion.
Seed cell suspension at 1 cell per well in ultra low-attachment 96-well plate.
Incubate ultra low-attachment 96-well plates under standard conditions at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Assess wells daily for sphere formation using microscope (with fluorescent capability if necessary).
Allow plates to incubate for 10 days or more.
Dissociate spheres mechanically using a P1000 pipette or chemically using pre-warmed trypsin-EDTA.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature (15°C-25°C).
Prepare cells in sphere media created in Step 1.
Seed 1 cell per well into a new ultra low-attachment 96-well plate.
Assess sphere-forming efficiency in secondary, tertiary, and quaternary passages using the formula from Step 6.
